Subject: [External] Notice of Availability of Final EA and Conclusion of Section 106 Consultation -
Christopher M. Crane Clean Energy Center

Good afternoon,

We are writing to inform Section 106 consulting parties that the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory
Commission (NRC) has completed its environmental review and National Historic
Preservation Act (NHPA), Section 106 consultation for the potential reauthorization of
power operations at the Christopher M. Crane Clean Energy Center (CCEC) (formerly
Three Mile Island Nuclear Station, Unit 1). The CCEC is located on Three Mile Island within
the Susquehanna River in Londonderry Township, Dauphin County, Pennsylvania,
approximately 10 miles southeast of Harrisburg.

As noted in previous correspondence, the NRC served as the lead Federal agency for the
environmental review under the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969, as amended
(NEPA), and for NHPA Section 106 consultation. The U.S. Department of Energy, Office of
Energy Dominance Financing served as a cooperating agency. The NRC conducted the
Section 106 consultation through the NEPA process per 36 CFR 800.8(c).
 The attached letter provides notification of the conclusion of the NHPA Section 106
consultation and the availability of the final Environmental Assessment (EA) and Finding of
No Significant Impact (FONSI) for the potential reauthorization of power operations at the
CCEC. The NRC initiated consultation with your office on February 2, 2026, and distributed
the draft EA to consulting parties for review and comment on June 4, 2026. The attached
letter summarizes the Section 106 consultation conducted for this review.

Based on the staff’s review of Constellation Energy Generation, LLC’s licensing and
regulatory requests, archaeological and architectural survey information, the associated
Section 106 consultation, and the staff’s independent assessment, the NRC staff has
determined that undertaking would result in no adverse effect on historic properties. The
NRC staff also concluded that impacts to historic and cultural resources would not be
significant under NEPA. The Pennsylvania State Historic Preservation Officer concurred on
these determinations on June 29, 2026.

The final EA and FONSI are available on the NRC’s CCEC project website at:
https://www.nrc.gov/facilities-safety/facility-finder/reactors/ccec. The Final EA is also
available at ML26231A018.

The Section 106 consulting parties have been notified by letter, and the public will be
notified via a Federal Register notice which is scheduled to be issued tomorrow, September
25, 2026.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

Thank you,

Jennifer A. Davis
Senior Environmental Project Manager / Archaeologist
Office of Advanced Reactors
U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission
(301) 415-3835
